data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2023 was GBP 0.209m (Balance Sheet). The report does not provide an explicit gross prior-year-only movement figure for prior underwriting years; the gross claims outstanding increased to GBP 1.023m at 31 December 2023, but this movement includes current year activity and therefore cannot be attributed solely to prior year re-estimation. Syndicate 1840 was placed into run-off at 31 December 2022 and is intended to be reinsured to close into Syndicate 457, which may affect comparability of triangle and movement metrics.
raw_causal_phrases: The provision for claims outstanding comprises the estimated cost of settling all claims occurring during the year, whether reported or not, including related direct and indirect claims handling costs.
In arriving at the level of claims provisions a margin is applied over and above the actuarial best estimate so no adverse run-off deviation is envisaged.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross figure for 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' was located. The technical provisions note provides a gross 'change in claims outstanding' (GBP 0.805m) but this includes current year movements and therefore was not used per the extraction rules. The claims development table is sparse (UW years 2020-2022) and does not permit a reliable calculation of prior-year-only development under the guidance (the two most recent UW years must be excluded and previous-diagonal comparisons are not available for the lone older year). Additionally, the Syndicate is in run-off and a planned reinsurance-to-close (RITC) into Syndicate 457 is noted in the report which may distort development metrics; this further limits ability to isolate prior-year development. Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet (liabilities) comparative column.
